newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary overnight rates finish at 23.375/625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary overnight rates finish at 23.375/625 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended below Wednesday's close but above Thursday's opening level in active trading on the first day of the new reserve period, dealers said.
The overnight rates ended at 23.375/23.625 percent, down from Wednesday's close of 27.50 percent but up from Thursday's opening of 23.00/23.25 percent, they added.
Traders said demand for funds was heavy today, which they attributed to players being cautious on reserves and to too much money still being anchored in last month's reserve repos.

"It seems like too many people got scared after seeing how high interest rates rose at the end of this past reserve period and before that they did not fall so much during the middle of the period," said Adam Szilagyi of ABM-AMRO Bank.
Banks are also a bit short of funds because they placed too much money in reserve repos last month, said Norbert Kaplar of Corvinbank.
He added that turnover was likely to have been above 20 billion forints.
